title: Piccolo Di Pargi Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Early, Prolific Pickling
description:
Grow your own delicious Italian heirloom gherkins!


KEY FEATURES
• Excellent cropper of small, flavourful gherkins
• Ideal for pickling or fresh consumption
• Early and productive over a long season
• Heirloom variety with intense taste
• Easy to grow from established mini plug plants


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Light Green
Season: Summer
Growth Habit: Climbing
Flavour: Intense, crisp, slightly sweet
Time to Harvest: 60-70 days from germination


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full Sun
Soil: Chalk, Sand, Loam, well-drained
Watering: Keep consistently moist to avoid bitterness
Spacing: 20cm apart in rows 100cm apart, or 90cm apart if trellising
Height: Climbing, can reach 1.5-2m
Spread: Up to 60cm
Hardiness: H1C (Half-hardy annual)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out after the last frost threat has passed and soil has warmed.
• Support climbing growth with a trellis or stakes for best results.
• Water regularly and deeply, especially during dry spells, to prevent bitterness.
• Harvest fruits frequently when 3-4 inches long to encourage continuous production.
• Feed with a balanced liquid fertiliser once fruits begin to set.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants


DISPATCH
Plants are carefully packed and dispatched Monday-Wednesday to avoid weekend delays.
